006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.Base64BinaryItemImpl;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.IBinaryItem;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
014
015import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
016
017import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
018
019/**
020 * An atomic Metapath item containing a Base64 encoded data value.
021 */
022public interface IBase64BinaryItem extends IBinaryItem {
023  /**
024   * Get the type information for this item.
025   *
026   * @return the type information
027   */
028  @NonNull
029  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IBase64BinaryItem> type() {
030    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.BASE64.getItemType();
031  }
032
033  @Override
034  default IAtomicOrUnionType<IBase64BinaryItem> getType() {
035    return type();
036  }
037
038  /**
039   * Base64 encode the provided string.
040   * <p>
041   * The provided string is first encoded as a stream of UTF8 bytes.
042   *
043   * @param text
044   *          the string to encode
045   * @return a base64 item representing the encoded data
046   */
047  static IBase64BinaryItem encode(@NonNull IStringItem text) {
048    return encode(text.asString());
049  }
050
051  /**
052   * Base64 encode the provided string.
053   * <p>
054   * The provided string is first encoded as a stream of UTF8 bytes.
055   *
056   * @param text
057   *          the string to encode
058   * @return a base64 item representing the encoded data
059   */
060  static IBase64BinaryItem encode(@NonNull String text) {
061    return valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.BASE64.encodeToByteBuffer(text));
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Base64 encode the provided bytes.
066   *
067   * @param bytes
068   *          the bytes to encode
069   * @return a base64 item representing the encoded data
070   */
071  @NonNull
072  static IBase64BinaryItem encode(@NonNull byte[] bytes) {
073    return valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.BASE64.encodeToByteBuffer(bytes));
074  }
075
076  /**
077   * Base64 encode the bytes from the provided buffer.
078   *
079   * @param buffer
080   *          the bytes to encode
081   * @return a base64 item representing the encoded data
082   */
083  @NonNull
084  static IBase64BinaryItem encode(@NonNull ByteBuffer buffer) {
085    return valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.BASE64.encodeToByteBuffer(buffer));
086  }
087
088  /**
089   * Base64 decode this item as a new hex binary item.
090   *
091   * @return a new hex binary item containing the decoded bytes
092   */
093  default IHexBinaryItem decode() {
094    return IHexBinaryItem.valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.BASE64.decode(asByteBuffer()));
095  }
096
097  /**
098   * Base64 decode this item as a string.
099   *
100   * @return a new string item containing the decoded text
101   */
102  default IStringItem decodeAsString() {
103    return IStringItem.valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.BASE64.decodeToString(asBytes()));
104  }
105
106  /**
107   * Construct a new base64 byte sequence item using the provided base64 encoded
108   * string {@code value}.
109   *
110   * @param value
111   *          a string representing base64 encoded data
112   * @return the new item
113   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
114   *           if the provided string is not a valid Base64 character sequence
115   */
116  @NonNull
117  static IBase64BinaryItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
118    try {
119      return valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.BASE64.parse(value));
120    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
121      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
122          null,
123          String.format("The value starting with '%s' is not a valid Base64 character sequence. %s",
124              value.substring(0, Math.min(value.length(), 200)),
125              ex.getLocalizedMessage()),
126          ex);
127    }
128  }
129
130  /**
131   * Construct a new URI base64 encoded byte sequence using the provided
132   * {@link ByteBuffer} {@code value}.
133   * <p>
134   * The provided buffer will be managed by this instance. Make a copy of the
135   * buffer to ensure that the position, limit, and mark of the original are not
136   * affect by this.
137   *
138   * @param buffer
139   *          a byte buffer
140   * @return the new item
141   */
142  @NonNull
143  static IBase64BinaryItem valueOf(@NonNull ByteBuffer buffer) {
144    return new Base64BinaryItemImpl(buffer);
145  }
146
147  /**
148   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
149   *
150   * @param item
151   *          the item to cast
152   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
153   *         cast to this type
154   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
155   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
156   */
157  @NonNull
158  static IBase64BinaryItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
159    try {
160      return item instanceof IBase64BinaryItem
161          ? (IBase64BinaryItem) item
162          : valueOf(item.asString());
163    } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
164      // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
165      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
166    }
167  }
168
169  @Override
170  default IBase64BinaryItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
171    return cast(item);
172  }
173
174  /**
175   * Compares this value with the argument.
176   *
177   * @param item
178   *          the item to compare with this value
179   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if this value is less
180   *         than, equal to, or greater than the {@code item}.
181   */
182  default int compareTo(@NonNull IBase64BinaryItem item) {
183    return asByteBuffer().compareTo(item.asByteBuffer());
184  }
185}
